summary: This case reaches the same missing selected-handler binding in js/cmd.js:doextcmd() as the other two v49 cases. The JavaScript switch has no dodrink case and falls through to UnsupportedHeroCommandBoundaryError. The handler is already implemented in js/potion.js; its direct-key route already retains the return result. This bounded divergence fix adds only the corresponding doextcmd() binding and does not claim the whole function as ported.
